case_name: Student clip 1 with five web references: a real teacher, three real students (one from a black-and-white archive portrait), a real classroom
title: The Next Paper, clip 1, five web references (MCP)

turns.text: One clip, 15 seconds, widescreen, no dialogue. Five pictures are attached and are the references: student-teacher.jpg is the TEACHER (the man in the grey long-sleeve shirt), web-evan.jpg is EVAN (the young man with braids), web-maya.jpg is MAYA (the young woman with the fringe; ignore the umbrella and the studio props, she is a student at a desk here), web-leo.jpg is LEO (the young man in the old black-and-white portrait; render him in colour, as a present-day student in casual clothes, keeping his face and hair), and student-classroom.jpg is the CLASSROOM (the scene must be this room: these desks, these windows, this green board). Each person must look exactly like their picture. The scene: in that classroom, the teacher walks along the row and hands Evan his returned test; Evan turns it over and the score '38/100' is clear; Maya, at the next desk, leans over and points at the score; Leo looks, smirks and nudges Maya; she covers a mocking grin; Evan lowers his eyes and pulls the paper toward himself, his hand covering the score at the end. Morning light from the windows.

tests: the four people match their pictures, the room matches its photo, the score reads 38/100, the actions in order
must_haves: The teacher is recognisably the man in student-teacher.jpg (face, hair, grey long-sleeve shirt).
Evan is recognisably the man in web-evan.jpg (face, braids); Maya the woman in web-maya.jpg (face, fringe); Leo the man in web-leo.jpg (face, hair), rendered in colour in present-day clothes.
The room is recognisably the classroom in student-classroom.jpg: the wooden desks, the big windows with trees, the green board.
The score on the paper reads exactly 38/100.
The actions in order: the teacher hands the test to Evan, Maya points at the score, Leo smirks and nudges Maya, Evan pulls the paper in and covers the score.
